changeSet.comment: Create Virology Laboratory notebook template with 10 workflow pages
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO notebook_page_type (id, template_id, page_type, "order", active) SELECT NEXTVAL('notebook_page_type_seq'), (SELECT id FROM notebook_template WHERE template_name = 'Virology Laboratory'), 'virology-sample-reception', 1, TRUE WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notebook_page_type npt JOIN notebook_template nt ON npt.template_id = nt.id WHERE nt.template_name = 'Virology Laboratory' AND npt.page_type = 'virology-sample-reception' );
